notes.title: Patch 1.0.10
notes.notes:
A bug that we just had to squash, in fact the name of the game depended on it!

[list]
[*] Fixed a rare issue where a character could die twice which meant a select few puzzles could be completed without killing everyone.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9
notes.notes:
Another small patch with some bug fixes alongside quality of life improvements for the gamepad.

General improvements:
[list]
[*] Fixed shadows in a variety of levels in which they were faulty.
[*] Fixed UI layout inconsistencies.
[*] Fixed an issue, when loading a save file for a puzzle, that prevented characters from behaving correctly on treasure chest.
[*] Fixed an issue, when loading a save file for a puzzle, where special items placed on tutorial object outlines could be deleted.
[*] The camera no longer clips into the wall in W03L1 "A delayed arrow hits another".
[*] Fixed cases where the level stats in the retry screen would display incorrect values.
[*] Improvised visual styling and navigation clarity of the category buttons in option and help menus.
[/list]

Gamepad specific:
[list]
[*] Change default keybind to go to next level to (A)/(X) on gamepad
[*] Added more UI feedback sounds for gamepad.
[*] Improved UI and sound feedback when spawning items with gamepad.
[*] Improved gamepad UI navigation, with focus on the help menu and options menu.
[*] Made it possible to navigate the help and options menu category buttons using the shoulder buttons on gamepad.
[*] Fixed navigation issues with the clear progress menu when using gamepad.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8
notes.notes:
Squashed a few more bugs!

General improvements:
[list]
[*] Fixed minor bug/inconsistency with pathfinding behaviour.
[*] Fixed an issue where characters did not correctly display footsteps despite having to move in order to shoot.
[*] Fixed a bug where if an alarm clock did not detect someone at the start it would not animate if a character walked into it later.
[*] Fixed an issue where characters affected by multiple alarm clocks did not correctly visualize they still were after removing one of them.
[*] Fixed an issue where characters did not display the bullseye as its target when affected by alarm clocks even though it was.
[*] Fixed an issue where the sound effect for hovering over buttons played twice.
[*] Fixed disconnecting controller or opening the Steam overlay during the loading screen would cause the loading screen to not register input.
[*] Fixed disconnecting controller or opening the Steam overlay during the win screen would cause the pause menu to open as well.
[*] Slight overall performance improvement
[/list]

Enhanced the video options screen:
[list]
[*] Provided a dynamic resolution selection with DLSS quality options.
[*] Corrected text for video options screen modes.
[*] Resolved layout problems in the video options menu.
[/list]
Gamepad specific:
[list]
[*] Fixed special item mode buttons on gamepad not playing sounds when pressed.
[*] Fixed controller glyphs in the help menu not working correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7
notes.notes:
A patch just in time for the weekend!

[list]
[*] It is now possible to press anywhere on a grid tile and the object on top of the grid tile will always be selected.
[*] The size of the main text of the tutorial windows has been slightly increased for better readability on SteamDeck.
[*] Fixed rare character animation bug.
[*] Updated Unity (game engine) for stability improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Happy new year!

Gameplay changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed characters not showing footsteps if they targeted a bullseye while standing on treasure chest coins.
[*] Fixed footsteps incorrectly being shown if removing one out of multiple treasure chests affecting the character at the time.
[*] Characters that have a target but are affected by treasure chest now play the correct idle animation.
[*] Characters that have a target but are affected by treasure chest will no longer place a target icon on them.
[*] When placing a treasure chest on a character it will now correctly play a particle effect.
[*] Pressing the button that rotates ("Q" or "D-Pad/Left") the object held now only plays a sound if it can be rotated.
[*] There is no longer a tiny amount of delay between the scene loading, revealing the absence of a puzzle and the wrong HUD, and the puzzle actually appearing.
[/list]
Level changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect camera collision with cliffs on "Bullet for a bullet".
[*] Fixed more ugly visual artefacts in the puzzle "The End".
[*] Characters no longer fall through the ground on W04L4 "Double shooters shoot double-shots".
[*] Decreased the brightness in the following levels: W01L2, W01L3, W02L1, W04L3, W05L3, W10L5, W15L2, W18L2, W19L1.
[*] Fixed lighting artefacts on: W01L5, W03L1, W09L5, W16L3.
[*] Updated level image on: W17L1.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Patch day!

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the projectile preview on character selection sometimes disappeared when it shouldn't.
[*] Fixed an issue where the projectile preview on character selection sometimes went through frying pans when it shouldn't in certain edge cases.
[*] Fixed graphical errors for the wooden platforms in the level "Saving the big bang until last".
[*] Fixed ugly artefacts on the ground in "The long way around".
[*] Fixed ugly artefacts on the ground in "The End".
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.notes:
It's that time of day again, a new patch for Everyone Must Die: A Western Standoff:

[list]
[*] Added the ability to click and drag to move the camera around, in the World Map and Puzzles, by pressing both Left Mouse Button and Right Mouse Button down at the same time. You can rebind this in the Options menu.
[*] Improved lighting and fixed minor collision issues on ~50 puzzles
[*] Fixed an instance where the gunsmoke turned blue in certain angles on "Long range bounce"
[*] Fixed an issue with the gamepad where the bind for the back button would stop working in menus.
[*] Improved failure handling if a puzzle save file fails to load
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Another small update with some minor fixes:

[list]
[*] Achievements completed in the demo build will now be given to the player directly when launching the standard version.
[*] Fixed situations where holding special items over the incorrect tutorial placement outline would show as a valid position when it shouldn't.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Small fix for a player reported bug:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the projectile line shown during character selection was red despite not having a target.
[/list]
